summary: Only current-form image is a 2026 drone aerial (last resort). All elevated game-day photos predate the 2024-26 renovation.

files.author: Quintin Soloviev

files.note: LAST RESORT - high oblique drone aerial (not a stands view), Feb 2026, empty, renovation finishing (new west-side tower at left, construction around the edge); field rows ~560-1050 of 1763 (32-60%) in the centre-left, bowl seating around it, city skyline in the top ~12%

closest_misses.why: Best elevated game photo (2011 Liberty Bowl at night, east lower stands looking at the press-box side, field rows ~55-75%), but it predates the 2024-26 renovation that rebuilt the west side, so it does not show the current form
2015 game-day panorama, 9544x3090, but fans' heads fill the bottom half and it predates the renovation
2022 Liberty Bowl from field-level stands; field is the bottom strip, pre-renovation
